relNote: Posting a sales order confirmation creates a CustConfirmJour header with CustConfirmTrans lines

def.name: CustConfirmJour
def.description: Posted sales order confirmation header; a purely documentary record with no financial (GL) impact, capturing the confirmed prices, quantities, and terms at the point of order acknowledgement.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: ConfirmId
fields.note: Confirmation document number; unique identifier for this posted confirmation

fields.name: SalesId
fields.note: Source sales order; links the confirmation back to the order

fields.name: ConfirmDate
fields.note: Date on which the confirmation was posted

fields.name: ConfirmAmount
fields.note: Total confirmed amount on the document

fields.name: OrderAccount
fields.note: Customer account number that placed the order

fields.name: InvoiceAccount
fields.note: Customer account to which the eventual invoice will be billed

fields.name: CurrencyCode
fields.note: Currency code for all monetary amounts on this confirmation

fields.name: DeliveryName
fields.note: Name of the delivery address for the shipment

fields.name: PurchaseOrder
fields.note: Customer's purchase order reference number

relNote: Line detail for a sales order confirmation; one row per confirmed order line

def.name: CustConfirmTrans
def.description: Individual line on a posted sales order confirmation; one row per confirmed sales line, holding the confirmed quantity, price, item, and inventory dimensions.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: ConfirmId
fields.note: FK to the parent confirmation header document

fields.name: SalesId
fields.note: Source sales order

fields.name: ItemId
fields.note: Item number on this confirmed line

fields.name: Qty
fields.note: Confirmed quantity in sales units

fields.name: InventQty
fields.note: Confirmed quantity in inventory units

fields.name: SalesPrice
fields.note: Unit price at the time of confirmation

fields.name: LineAmount
fields.note: Net line amount (qty x price minus discounts)

fields.name: InventDimId
fields.note: Inventory dimension combination (site, warehouse, batch, etc.)

fields.name: InventTransId
fields.note: Inventory transaction ID linking to the underlying inventory movement

relNote: Posted delivery note header created when goods are physically shipped to the customer; has financial impact on inventory (COGS posting)

def.name: CustPackingSlipJour
def.description: Posted delivery note (packing slip) header; created when goods are physically shipped from the warehouse. Unlike confirmations, this document has financial impact — it triggers inventory cost-of-goods-sold postings in the GL.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: PackingSlipId
fields.note: Packing slip document number; unique identifier for this posted delivery note

fields.name: SalesId
fields.note: Source sales order; links the delivery note back to the order

fields.name: DeliveryDate
fields.note: Actual date of physical shipment/delivery

fields.name: OrderAccount
fields.note: Customer account that placed the order

fields.name: InvoiceAccount
fields.note: Customer account to be invoiced

fields.name: LedgerVoucher
fields.note: GL voucher number for the inventory COGS posting triggered by this shipment

fields.name: DocumentDate
fields.note: Document date on the packing slip (may differ from DeliveryDate)

fields.name: DlvMode
fields.note: Mode of delivery (e.g. truck, air, courier)

fields.name: SourceDocumentHeader
fields.note: FK to the source document header used for accounting framework integration

relNote: Line detail for a delivery note; one row per shipped item line, links to InventTrans for inventory tracking

def.name: CustPackingSlipTrans
def.description: Individual line on a posted delivery note (packing slip); one row per shipped item line, holding the delivered quantity, item, inventory dimensions, and the remaining quantity not yet invoiced.

fields.name: RecId
fields.note: Surrogate primary key

fields.name: PackingSlipId
fields.note: FK to the parent packing slip header document

fields.name: SalesId
fields.note: Source sales order

fields.name: ItemId
fields.note: Item number on this shipped line

fields.name: Qty
fields.note: Delivered quantity in sales units

fields.name: inventQty
fields.note: Delivered quantity in inventory units

fields.name: Remain
fields.note: Quantity from this packing slip line not yet invoiced

fields.name: InventDimId
fields.note: Inventory dimension combination (site, warehouse, batch, serial, etc.)

fields.name: InventTransId
fields.note: Inventory transaction ID linking to the physical inventory issue

fields.name: AmountCur
fields.note: Line amount in the transaction currency (used for packing-slip-level valuation)
